name: WDOnline Print Order for WooCommerce
author: wdonlinedk

sections.description:
WDOnline Print Order for WooCommerce adds print actions to individual orders and the WooCommerce order list.

Features:

  • Print an order confirmation or packing slip from an order.
  • Print multiple selected orders using WooCommerce bulk actions.
  • Generate an aggregated pick list across multiple selected orders.
  • Optionally show product images and GTIN on aggregated pick lists.
  • Track printed and packed orders directly in the order list.
  • Filter orders by print and packing status.
  • Sort products by name, SKU, GTIN or category.
  • Show all order item metadata except exclusions, or print only selected metadata.
  • Discover metadata keys from recent orders and optionally customize printed labels.
  • Optional prices, SKU, GTIN, product images and customer notes.
  • Configurable company name, details and logo.
  • Optional automatic opening of the browser print dialog.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • No customer or order information is sent to external services.

Privacy

The plugin does not send order data, personal information, telemetry or diagnostics to external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Configure it under WD Online > Print Order.
  4. Open a WooCommerce order and use the Print order panel.
sections.faq:
Can I hide prices on a packing slip?

Yes. Prices are hidden on packing slips by default and can be enabled in the plugin settings.

Can I print several orders at once?

Yes. Select the orders in the WooCommerce order list and choose one of the print bulk actions.

  • Added the standard discreet WD Online support box with the current PayPal/card support link.
  • Registered administration scripts and styles before enqueueing them to match the plugin project standards.
  • Restored the public Author URI and added the public plugin product page as Plugin URI.
  • Improved request handling by unslashing packed-status query values before validation.
  • Refreshed the translation template for the new support text.

0.4.2

  • Moved all print-view JavaScript to a properly enqueued external file.
  • Removed inline event handlers and inline administration styles.
  • Removed website URI headers while the URLs are unavailable to WordPress.org validation.

0.4.1

  • Added the plugin-specific WD Online product page URL.
  • Corrected the feature list after removal of the footer setting.

0.4.0

  • Added optional product images to aggregated pick lists.
  • Added a separate option for showing or hiding GTIN on aggregated pick lists.
  • Added variation image support with a parent product image fallback.

0.3.1

  • Added the required translator context for the aggregated order count.
  • Documented the intentional metadata query used by the administrator order status filter.

0.3.0

  • Added separate metadata display modes for packing slips and order confirmations.
  • Added exact allowlists for printing only selected order item metadata.
  • Added optional custom labels using the key|Label format.
  • Added a list of public metadata keys detected in the 50 most recent orders.
  • Preserved the existing exclusion-based metadata behavior after updating.

0.2.1

  • Added the required quantity beside each order number on aggregated pick lists.
  • Combined quantities correctly when the same product appears more than once in an order.

0.2.0

  • Added aggregated pick lists with total quantities and related order numbers.
  • Added product sorting by name, SKU, GTIN or category.
  • Added print and packed status tracking with an order list column.
  • Added order filters for printed, not printed, packed and not packed orders.
  • Added single-order and bulk actions for marking orders packed or not packed.
  • Added configurable hidden metadata rules for packing slips and confirmations.
  • Improved multipage printing with repeated table headers and protected product rows.

0.1.7

  • Removed pre-order notices from packing slip product metadata.
  • Preserved variation attributes and other relevant item metadata.
  • Kept pre-order information available on order confirmations.
  • Added a filter for developers to adjust printed order item metadata.

0.1.6

  • Added a Settings link to the plugin action links on the Plugins screen.
  • Replaced the visible logo URL field with the WordPress Media Library selector.
  • Added logo preview and remove controls.
  • Preserved existing logo URLs as a backward-compatible fallback.

0.1.5

  • Fixed the Close button after bulk printing.
  • Close now returns to the previous order list when the print view uses the current browser tab.
  • Printing from an individual order continues to close its separate print tab.

0.1.4

  • Routed bulk printing through the plugin’s registered WD Online settings page.
  • Removed the hidden WooCommerce page route that could be rejected by some admin menu configurations.
  • Kept print rendering early enough to prevent WordPress administration markup from entering the document.

0.1.3

  • Fixed the WordPress permission error when opening the bulk print screen.
  • Registered the secure print route as a hidden WooCommerce administration page.
  • Kept the print route out of the visible WooCommerce menu.

0.1.2

  • Fixed blank output when printing multiple orders from WooCommerce bulk actions.
  • Replaced the reserved admin-post action URL with a dedicated secure admin route.
  • Registered and enqueued the print stylesheet according to WordPress requirements.
  • Removed the discouraged manual translation loader; WordPress loads translations automatically.
  • Updated the WordPress tested version header.

0.1.1

  • Added a translation template and explicit Loco Translate support.
  • Moved the settings page into the shared WD Online admin menu.
  • Removed the document footer text setting and output.
  • Suppressed browser-generated print headers and footers where supported.
  • Confirmed bulk actions for both classic orders and HPOS order screens.
  • Added optional WooCommerce GTIN, UPC, EAN or ISBN output with variation fallback.

0.1.0

  • Initial development release.
  • Added order confirmations and packing slips.
  • Added single-order and bulk print actions.
  • Added configurable document content and company details.
  • Added HPOS compatibility declaration.
  • Added optional WD Online Support Diagnostics integration.
